home.h1: Used car engines, tested and graded
home.lead: Every engine has its own test sheet: compression for each cylinder, the checks and the donor car. The grade sets the warranty, from 3 to 12 months.
home.heroAlt: A BMW B58 straight-six engine hanging on two chains, seen from the exhaust side
home.carLine: No code to hand? Pick the make, model and year, and we show the engines that fit.
home.carAlt: Mercedes M256 engine from the gearbox end, flexplate fitted, on lifting straps
home.how1Text: Send your name, phone and VIN. The engine comes off the list for 48 hours and nobody else can buy it.
home.how1Alt: Mercedes M256 engine on lifting straps, seen from the turbo side
home.how2Title: A fit check by your VIN
home.how2Text: We check your VIN against the engine code and the donor car, and call you with the answer before you pay anything.
home.how2Alt: Factory label on a Mercedes engine with the part number A 256 010 08 03
home.how3Title: Payment by bank transfer, then delivery
home.how3Text: You get an invoice with the delivery price for your country. Once it is paid, the engine leaves Slovakia strapped to a pallet.
home.how3Alt: Mercedes OM654 diesel engine on white, belt drive and sump in view

R.name: Grade R
R.text: A new engine, or one rebuilt with new bearings, rings and gaskets. Never fitted since.

A.name: Grade A
A.text: Every cylinder within 8% of nominal compression, every check passed, low spread.

B.name: Grade B
B.text: Compression within spec. One point is noted on the sheet, with what we did about it.

C.name: Grade C
C.text: Runs and holds compression above the minimum. The notes say what needs doing first.

gradesPage.title: Grades and warranty
gradesPage.description: How EngineMarket grades used engines R, A, B and C from the test sheet, and the warranty each grade carries.
gradesPage.lead: Each engine gets one grade from its test sheet. The grade sets how long the warranty runs, counted from the day the engine is delivered.
gradesPage.measureLine: Three things on the sheet decide it. The photograph shows the crankshaft of an engine we graded R.
gradesPage.m1: Compression in each cylinder, against the maker's nominal value and minimum
gradesPage.m2: The spread between the highest and lowest cylinder
gradesPage.m3: Six checks: oil, coolant, leaks, turbo shaft play, timing, start test
gradesPage.cover1A: The engine block, cylinder head, crankshaft, camshafts and the parts inside them. If one fails within the warranty, we send a replacement engine or refund the price.
gradesPage.cover2A: Damage from overheating, wrong oil, a failed fitting or parts not listed as included. Belts, seals and gaskets are wear parts.
gradesPage.cover3A: A garage invoice for the fitting, with new oil, filter and coolant. Keep it with the test sheet.
gradesPage.cover4A: Email us the engine number, the fitting invoice and a description of the fault. We answer within one working day.
gradesPage.photoAlt: A crankshaft from a Mercedes-AMG M139 engine, standing on end on a white bench

errors.name: Write your name, at least two letters.
errors.email: Write an email address with an @, like name@garage.sk.
errors.phone: Write a phone number with the country code, like +421 900 123 456.
errors.country: Choose the country we deliver to.
errors.vin: Write the 17-character VIN from the registration document. It has no I, O or Q.
errors.car: Write the make, model and year of your car.
errors.codeOrVin: Keep the engine code or VIN under 60 characters.
errors.vatId: Write the VAT ID with its country prefix, like SK2020123456.
errors.volume: Choose how many engines you buy a month.
errors.question: Write your question, at least a few words.
